content:
maria_cs: Heads-up — Bluecliff onboarding health dipped after recent latency spikes, thinking we should proactively propose a compact-routing + quant plan.

sam_se: Quick numbers? can you paste the p95/p99 and token stats?

maria_cs: p50 ~120ms, p95 420ms, p99 ~1.2s. Avg tokens per request: 420. Peak traffic 2–4pm UTC. Model in prod: gpt-xl-bridge-v2 (fp16). Renewal check-in in 3w, CS sentiment softened.

jamie_re: Renewal is definitely at-risk if we don't show cost/latency wins. They called out slow responses on support workflows. :grimacing:

sam_se: Proposal: split routing by token length + int8 quant for short flows. Route ~70% of traffic (<=200 tokens) -> gpt-compact-4q (int8). Keep 30% -> gpt-xl-bridge-v2 for long/critical queries. Canary 5% traffic for 24h, measure latency, error rate, and quality (bleu/perplexity proxies).

maria_cs: Also add prefix KV caching for repeated system prompts + 1h TTL — they repeat same system prompt a lot which inflates compute.

opsbot: Suggestion created: bluecliff/preemptive-quant-split/8001234567 (canary job queued)

sam_se: Minimal config snippet to deploy canary:
```
route_rules:
  - match: "tokens <= 200"
    model: "gpt-compact-4q"
    quant: "int8"
  - match: "tokens > 200"
    model: "gpt-xl-bridge-v2"
    quant: "fp16"
canary: 5%
monitoring:
  metrics: [p50,p95,p99,error_rate,token_delta,hallucination_rate]
  eval_prompt_set: bluecliff-core-200
```

maria_cs: Action items: 1) Enablement call with Bluecliff tomorrow 10:00am PT (@jamie_re + @sam_se). 2) Collect 200 sample prompts for quality gating (I'll capture during the call). 3) Add regen/hallucination checks to the dashboard and cost projection for renewal pack.

jamie_re: I'll own the enablement & prompt capture. I'll ask them to mark representative
